root_cause: The need ledger (_initial_objective_oc_needs: enemy OC - friendly OC + 1, COORD-5 projected need) correctly says when an objective's OC is surplus, but two later steps credit OC that changes no control. (1) s7475 r3 P1: pass 1 of _assign_units_to_objectives holds EVERY movable unit on a held_threatened objective (`elif obj_state == "held_threatened": should_hold = true`) even when remaining need is 0 - obj_center was held 20 vs 9 (projected ~7), Custodian Guard Beta's 9 OC changed nothing there (11 stays > 9) while obj_nml_1 (enemy_weak, 8 OC) needed it; held_safe extras are already freed via KEEP-OC/keeper, held_threatened ones never were. (2) s7478 r3 P2: OBJ-ASSIGN-1 swaps a 'quicker' unit in for the greedy pick when it merely arrives with more spare inches in the SAME Movement phase (both 2 phases) - same Command phase, no VP gained - parking Custodian Guard Beta (OC 9) on an uncontested objective needing OC 1 that the Prosecutors (OC 8) were taking, and so removing its OC from the contested centre/nml_1 where it changes control. (3) s7463 r1 P2 (Orks, base now goes to obj_nml_2 via the support/screen fallback): obj_center's need 6 is marked covered by two Battlewagons arriving in 3 turns, so Kommandos (2 turns, Advance score 12.3 > 9.7) is skipped - the ledger is time-blind (OC arriving later counted as present now). This third mechanism is NOT addressed by this design (a time-indexed ledger is a larger change and Kommandos are LONE-TRIP-fragile at a 56-OC race).
fix_summary: FIX_MARGINAL_OC (const 1.0, get_param). (a) Pass 1: on a held_threatened objective whose remaining need is 0, a movable holder is freed to pass 2 when the friendly OC that stays without it (and without holders already freed from it) is > 0 and > max(enemy OC in range, projected enemy OC one move away) - the same threat measure KEEP-OC/keeper-pick use; otherwise it holds as before. Helper _marginal_oc_holder_surplus(). (b) OBJ-ASSIGN-1: an alternative unit that arrives in the SAME number of phases is not swapped in when its OC exceeds max(greedy pick's OC, remaining need) (surplus OC parked where it changes nothing). Phase-sooner swaps unchanged. Both print [MARGINAL_OC]. 0 = base exactly (both branches gated).

risks: (a) frees a held_threatened holder with a thin margin (strict >, same as the ledger): the threat is enemy OC in range or one move away (max, not sum), and melee in the following Fight phase can kill models of the units that stay - a freed unit could lose a held objective the stay-behind units cannot keep after casualties (e.g. s7475: 11 vs 9 in range, projected 7). Over 5 rounds this sends more units forward from held objectives (round 2-5), which also helps secondaries needing units across the table, but can lose primary on a held centre if the enemy charges in. Home objectives are included when held_threatened (seen once: 5 OC stays vs 2). (b) narrow (same-phase swaps only, OC larger than both the greedy pick and the need); the swapped-out unit's next choice is whatever pass 2 scores next (s7478: obj_nml_1, not the centre the critic measured), unmeasured. s7463 (time-blind ledger) not addressed. Not tested with FIX_WAAAGH_ADVANCE_CHARGE / FIX_R1_SUPPORT_ADVANCE. KEEPER-RELEASE lesson: (a) does not touch the held_safe keeper path.
